_metadata.note_wait_time: WaitTime = cast startup ticks (animation startup before skill fires)
_metadata.note_time_per_cast: TimePerCast = cooldown ticks between skill uses (0 = no explicit CD)
_metadata.note_fly_event_time: FlyEventTime = tick when fly-phase event fires on missile
_metadata.note_phases: Granular sub-tick phases (hit_stop, recovery_lock, combo_window) are in C++ engine binary, not in Lua/settings. Data below is what scripts define.

attack_speed_modifiers._note: These are percentage modifiers to base attack speed, NOT frame counts
